data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 revenue was about $97.69 billion, with gross profit of about $17.45 billion, giving a gross margin of roughly 17.9%. Operating income was about $7.08 billion, an operating margin of roughly 7.2%. These figures come from Tesla's FY2024 Form 10-K, filed in January 2025, so you may want to confirm them against that filing if you need exact values for a report.
